Hello,

I am applying for the UI/UX Designer role at Unico Connect, specifically drawn to your focus on crafting production-ready interfaces and partnering closely with engineering on dev-mode handoff.

During my UI/UX internship at AT Creation and my current role at Ascent Business Solutions, I built over 100 digital assets and ran usability tests to refine user flows. My Computer Science degree gives me strong technical foundations for dev-mode handoffs.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates end-to-end user research and wireframing for a B2B platform, available in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Would you be open to a quick fifteen-minute call next week to discuss my work? I am currently based in Nagpur and ready to relocate to Mumbai.

Ananya

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/
